# `aitbc dispute active`

List every dispute still open for arbitration.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dispute active [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain node RPC URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dispute active
```
